info.title: Static Site Host
info.description:
Stock nginx serving a static web build under the snap base path. Routing is prefix-based (the gateway forwards the full prefix to the container); this spec exists only to (a) mark the surface as PUBLIC via x-snapser-auth-passthrough so the gateway does not require a session token, and (b) satisfy SDK/API-Explorer generation. Only THIS snap's routes are affected — other snaps in the snapend keep full auth.

OpenAPI path templating matches a single segment, so {path} below does not literally enumerate nested files (e.g. /assets/foo.wasm). The same-snapend smoke test answers whether the gateway honors passthrough prefix-wide for unenumerated nested paths; if it does not, fall back to a dedicated Auth-less snapend (see README).
